An Invitation to Healing

Reiki is the art of connecting with the universal life force — a current of love that restores balance to body, mind, and spirit. Inner Child work is the art of listening to the soul’s earliest voice — the innocent self who remembers joy, curiosity, and wonder. Together, they create a bridge between energy and emotion, past and present, the child and the adult within. In Inner Child Reiki, you will:
  • Learn the foundations of the Usui Reiki system and its four levels of initiation.
  • Experience attunements that open your energetic channels and awaken intuitive sensitivity.
  • Explore intuitive and energy-based healing with a focus on self-awareness and self-trust.
  • Integrate Reiki with Inner Child practices, using energy to bring safety, balance, and love to the inner child.
This training honours Reiki’s lineage while opening it to a new dimension of emotional and spiritual integration.

Your Practitioner: Amy Grist

After graduating with a Master’s Degree in Investigative Forensic Psychology in London, I developed programs and practices that have supported many people through meaningful transformation. I understand that true healing is not limited to therapy alone — it lives in the everyday choices, habits and ways we relate to ourselves. My approach is holistic, integrating mind, body, intuition and emotional healing. Over the years I’ve trained and worked as an:
  • Inner Child Practitioner
  • Trauma-Informed Integration Specialist
  • Yoga Teacher
  • Meditation Guide
  • Reiki Master
  • Trainer, Mentor and Intuitive Energy Guide
